commentary: With the deterministic gate at CAUTION and breadth score at 49, market direction demands strict discipline. While the Nifty 50 snapped a six-week losing streak on large-cap defensives, mid- and small-cap indices closed lower, displaying distribution divergence. As William O'Neil warned, three out of four stocks follow the general market trend; breakouts during market divergences fail at elevated rates. Stan Weinstein's stage discipline dictates honoring Stage 2 leaders while ruthlessly avoiding laggards or non-equity instruments. In this tape, Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rule is paramount: initiate small pilot positions in high-volume breakouts only, demand immediate traction, and enforce uncompromising stop discipline at the scanner's risk thresholds.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above its rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, hovering within 1.5% of its 103.06 pivot on modest volume (1.21x). However, price action shows loose volatility without a clean Minervini VCP contraction, and relative strength remains sluggish compared to true market leaders.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Small-cap pharmaceutical trader suffers from wafer-thin operating margins (~2-3%), low ROE (~3-5%), and a 56% top-line collapse in Q1 FY27. Unreliable profitability, high beta, and lack of institutional sponsorship fail CANSLIM and SEPA fundamental criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Break below the 94.11 stop invalidates the pivot setup; cut losses immediately to prevent compounding drawdowns in an illiquid microcap.

ABBOTINDIA.technical: Stage 2 advancing profile marked by a decisive 20-session breakout at 28,968.94 on massive institutional accumulation (5.07x volume). Price sits properly aligned above upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 63 confirms healthy momentum without technical extension.
ABBOTINDIA.fundamental: Impeccable balance sheet with zero debt, high return on capital (ROCE > 40%), and strong MNC institutional pedigree. However, top-line growth (+4%) and EPS growth (+17%) fall short of CANSLIM's 25% minimum hurdle rate.
ABBOTINDIA.risk: Close below 27,801.08 stop violates the breakout level; respect the stop to guard against institutional distribution in a cautious market.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Constructing a double-bottom pattern above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, pressing against neckline resistance at 431.13. Volume expanded to 1.77x on recent up-days, with RSI at 52 reflecting calm, orderly base accumulation rather than frantic chasing.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Supported by robust lending expansion with NBFC AUM up 28% and housing finance surging 50%, driving 29% revenue growth in Q1 FY27. However, moderate ROE (~12%) and steady but sub-25% EPS growth prevent a top-tier CANSLIM rating.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Drop below 410.13 stop breaks swing-low support and violates neckline integrity, requiring immediate loss execution.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: Debt ETF trading in an ultra-tight, yield-driven band near 1,006. While technically above moving averages due to daily interest accrual, standard equity trend templates, VCP contractions, and breakout setups are wholly inapplicable.
ABSLLIQUID.fundamental: Exchange-traded overnight fund investing in tri-party repo (TREPS) and overnight debt securities. It has zero corporate sales, earnings, operating margins, or equity ownership metrics.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Severe opportunity cost relative to equity momentum; serves solely as a cash-parking vehicle, not an active swing trading instrument.

ACE.technical: Textbook SEPA Stage 2 continuation breakout to new 52-week highs, clearing the 1,214.41 pivot on strong 2.87x volume expansion. Moving averages are in pristine bullish sequence (EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200), showing leading relative strength against declining midcaps.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant 63% domestic crane market share with operating margins expanding to 20.4%. Q1 FY27 revenue rose 20% with PAT up 22%. Near-zero debt, 31% ROCE, and tailwinds in infrastructure and defense support the growth narrative.
ACE.risk: A break back below the 1,123.57 stop signals a false breakout; execute strict stop-loss discipline to protect trading capital.

ACMESOLAR.technical: High-conviction Stage 2 SEPA breakout to new 52-week highs, clearing 430.93 on tremendous institutional demand (4.89x average volume). Moving averages are stacked positively, displaying standout relative strength while broader mid/small-caps soften.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Renewable energy IPP demonstrating explosive growth: Q1 FY27 sales grew 68% and PAT surged 65% on capacity additions. Capital intensity keeps debt high, but rapid capacity execution and rising operating margins provide strong fundamental momentum.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Violation of the 394.55 stop level invalidates the breakout; exit immediately without hesitation per Minervini risk rules.
